candidate_root_contribution: غ ل ظ marks the DENSE / THICK / STOUT pole — being substantial and firm, and hence resistant to softening, yielding, or breaking. It is the antithesis of soft/thin/pliant. The concrete anchor is 48:29 (فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ), a crop-shoot thickening into a stout stalk; the same non-softness is projected onto disposition (hard heart 3:159, stern angels 66:6, commanded sternness 9:73/66:9, ghilẓa in combat 9:123). The root does NOT itself carry moral valence — context supplies it (commanded, angelic and covenantal uses are approved; hard-heartedness is disapproved). It is distinct from shidād (power/might, co-occurs at 66:6), from fazz (coarse manner, distinguished at 3:159), and from ʿaẓīm (magnitude, used separately at 48:29).

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: An occurrence in which غلظ denotes the SOFT/thin/pliant/lenient pole, or is shown internally to be synonymous with شِدَاد (power) or with فَظّ (coarse speech) rather than distinct from them.
rejection_condition.search_location: The antonym frame at 3:159 (لِنتَ ↔ غَلِيظَ ٱلْقَلْبِ) and the co-deployment frames 66:6 (غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ) and 3:159 (فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلْقَلْبِ); the literal anchor 48:29.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Check whether any occurrence pairs غلظ with a softness/lenience gloss, or whether the شِدَاد/فَظّ co-occurrences are redundant (synonymic) rather than contrastive; re-read 48:29 for any non-density literal sense.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Separate root-carried meaning from context-supplied valence (approved vs disapproved uses are NOT semantic variants); treat عَذَاب غَلِيظ and مِيثَاق غَلِيظ as lexicalized collocations, not free compositional evidence, so their reading is not double-counted as core support.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If softness/synonymy is found, the non-softness nucleus and the negative boundaries collapse and the account must drop toward WEAK or split into unbridged senses (UNRESOLVED).

reopen_conditions: If a future analysis supplies a Quran-internal bridge that ties عَذَاب غَلِيظ (11:58, 14:17, 31:24, 41:50) to the non-softness nucleus (e.g., an occurrence contrasting a 'severe' punishment with a 'soft/light' one using this root), promoting the punishment cluster from RESISTANT and possibly lifting the grade toward STRONG.
